steps.text: Summarize this story in one sentence. A small library kept its oldest books in a quiet room upstairs. Every Friday the librarian carried a different book downstairs, read the opening page to the visitors, and invited them to borrow it. One Friday a child brought a book written by her grandfather, and the librarian made room on the shelf for it.
